title: Superior Courts Court Dress and Mode of Ddress Order Repeal Act 2020

sections.shortTitle: Superior Courts Court Dress and Mode of Ddress Order Repeal Act 2020
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT VIII OF 2020
ACT VIII OF 2020
SUPERIOR COURTS (COURT DRESS AND MODE OF
ADDRESS) ORDER (REPEAL) ACT, 2020
An Act to repeal the President's Order No. 15 of
1980
[Gazette of Pakistan Extraordinary, Part I,
22nd February, 2020]
No.
F. 9 (11)/2020-Legis, dated 21.2.2020.---The following Act of Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent
of the President on 18th February, 2020 and is hereby published for general
information:-
WHEREAS
it is expedient to repeal the Superior Courts (Court Dress and Mode of Address)
Order, 1980 (P.O. No. 15 of 1980);
It
is hereby enacted as follows:
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be called the Superior Courts (Court Dress and Mode of Address) Order
(Repeal) Act, 2020.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.
